title: South Sudan Parliament Amends 2018 Peace Agreement to Clear Path for December Elections
detail: July 1, 2026 — South Sudan's parliament approved amendments to the 2018 Revitalized Agreement on the Resolution of the Conflict in South Sudan (R-ARCSS), removing the requirement for a population census and a permanent constitution before the December 22, 2026 elections; both tasks were deferred to the incoming elected government. Opposition lawmakers challenged the amendments' legality, and SPLM-IO leader Riek Machar's faction — under house arrest since March 2026 and facing treason charges — was excluded from the consultations that reaffirmed the election timeline, raising concerns about the vote's inclusivity.

title: Amnesty International Documents RSF Atrocities and Ethnic Cleansing in El Fasher, North Darfur
detail: July 1, 2026 — Amnesty International published 'City Under Siege, Children Under Fire,' documenting Rapid Support Forces crimes against humanity and ethnic cleansing in North Darfur between early 2024 and October 2025, based on 247 interviews and 89 videos plus satellite imagery. The report details mass killings, sexual violence (26 survivors interviewed), and forced child recruitment, including the October 26, 2025 berm massacre where survivors reported more than 1,000 bodies. The findings fed directly into international pressure surrounding the US-brokered peace proposal then under discussion between Sudan's Armed Forces and the RSF, underscoring the transitional-justice stakes of any eventual settlement.
